paragraphs: Career TEAM works on unemployment and poverty for government agencies, pairing staffed services with software. The software is Career EDGE, and the company says every one of its projects runs on it.

The programs covered include WIOA adult, dislocated worker and youth services. On the software side the listed pieces are case management, business services and training. Work also reaches justice involved people: in 2023 the company was selected for a Missouri pilot serving 19,000 returning citizens from thirteen detention centers.

Career TEAM has been serving job seekers and government organizations since 1996. Chris and Sue Kuselias launched the company that year. By 2022 staff had grown past 300 employees with offices in 15 states. Aaron Kelley became chief executive in 2024. In October 2025 it took over management and operations of the workforce development system in North Central Texas.
